Title: Chenille Patches
Body (HTML):
Chenille patches offer the timeless look of classic varsity letters with the versatility of modern design. These patches feature a plush, textured surface that stands out, paired with a sturdy felt background, making them perfect for jackets, sweaters, and bags. Each patch can be customized with a variety of bold colors and can include intricate details and lettering.

Each patch order includes a free roll of Thermal Tape.
